exposure: Type of surgery (laparoscopic adrenalectomy vs. emergency surgery)
cohort: Ten patients diagnosed with pheochromocytoma during pregnancy
finding: Maternal and fetal prognosis of pheochromocytoma in pregnancy improved over the last decades, but still lethal consequences may be present if misdiagnosed or mistreated.
mod_finding: Newborns from the group with planned adrenalectomy before delivery were all healthy, while two out of three newborns in the emergency surgery group died shortly after delivery secondary to cardiac and pulmonary complications.
gest_age: 10th to 29th weeks of pregnancy at diagnosis
